closure_requirements.name: episode-right-revocation
closure_requirements.requirement: Every per-episode dispatch right is revoked on normal return, exception and cancellation.

closure_requirements.name: component-evidence-binding
closure_requirements.requirement: Specialist reachability/feedback/persistence stages advance only from component-specific verified evidence.

closure_requirements.name: fresh-process-replay
closure_requirements.requirement: RESTART_VERIFIED requires artifact-bound fresh-process restart/replay evidence, not same-process reload.

closure_requirements.name: organ-lifetime-identity
closure_requirements.requirement: Recomposition preserves or retires organ identities so subsequent tasks cannot collide on duplicate organ ids.

closure_requirements.name: canonical-custody
closure_requirements.requirement: Adaptive knowledge is tenant/creator bound and persisted through canonical OVID/THESEUS custody/state rather than a private JSON authority.

closure_requirements.name: negative-transfer-detection
closure_requirements.requirement: A mismatched curriculum that degrades identification is detected and produces an auditable abandon/replan/remediation decision.

claim_boundary: Reported local research evidence is preserved. Whole-product production readiness is unavailable until every closure requirement is directly evidenced on the integrated source head.
